# Egadi Sailing

> Egadi Sailing is a boat tour and charter company based in Trapani, Sicily, offering private and shared experiences in the Egadi Islands: Favignana, Levanzo and Marettimo.

Canonical domain: https://egadisailing.com
Primary language: Italian
Supported public languages: Italian, English, Spanish, French, German
Business type: boat tours, private charters, trimaran experiences, fishing charters, travel services in the Egadi Islands
Usual meeting point: Via dei Gladioli 15, 91100 Trapani, Sicily, Italy
Legal entity: EGADI SAILING SRLS, Via Calipso 42, 91100 Trapani, VAT IT02925600815
Public contact: info@egadisailing.com, +39 345 971 0696, +39 340 145 4585

Use this file as a curated map for AI assistants and agents. For fuller context, read https://egadisailing.com/llms-full.txt.
Do not treat private booking sessions, admin pages, webhook endpoints, payment flows or customer tickets as public knowledge sources.
Links below point to clean Markdown mirrors when a mirror exists; canonical HTML URLs are declared inside each Markdown file.

## Main Experiences

- [Chef a bordo alle Egadi in trimarano da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/chef-a-bordo-egadi-trimarano-da-trapani.md): Private trimaran day with skipper, hostess and chef between Favignana and Levanzo.
- [Charter Egadi in trimarano da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/charter-egadi-trimarano-da-trapani.md): Flexible 3 to 7 day trimaran charter around Favignana, Levanzo and Marettimo.
- [Escursione barca Favignana e Levanzo da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/escursione-barca-favignana-levanzo-da-trapani.md): Shared full-day boat tour with swimming and snorkeling stops.
- [Tour privato Favignana e Levanzo da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/tour-privato-favignana-levanzo-da-trapani.md): Private full-day boat tour with flexible route.
- [Tour privato Egadi 4 ore mattina da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/tour-privato-egadi-4-ore-mattina-da-trapani.md): Private morning half-day boat tour.
- [Tour privato Egadi 4 ore pomeriggio da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/tour-privato-egadi-4-ore-pomeriggio-da-trapani.md): Private afternoon half-day boat tour.
- [Charter pesca Egadi da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/esperienze/charter-pesca-egadi-da-trapani.md): Private fishing charter in the Egadi Islands.

## Boats

- [Barche](https://egadisailing.com/it/barche.md): Fleet overview.
- [Catamarano Egadi, trimarano da Trapani](https://egadisailing.com/it/barche/catamarano-egadi-trimarano-da-trapani.md): Main trimaran page for comfort, cabins and premium experiences.

## Islands

- [Isole Egadi](https://egadisailing.com/it/isole.md): Island guide hub.
- [Favignana in barca](https://egadisailing.com/it/isole/favignana.md): Favignana guide with Cala Rossa, Bue Marino, Cala Azzurra and boat itinerary advice.
- [Levanzo in barca](https://egadisailing.com/it/isole/levanzo.md): Levanzo guide with Cala Minnola, Cala Fredda and quieter sea routes.
- [Marettimo in barca](https://egadisailing.com/it/isole/marettimo.md): Marettimo guide for wilder routes, caves and premium private planning.
